description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuQuestion" name="Menu or burger question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Burger preparation status update"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenuChoice" name="Ask whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" name="Receive menu or burger choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuSplit" name="Prepare menu components in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskSideChoice" name="Ask whether the customer wants fries or wedges" messageRef="Message_SideQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" name="Receive fries or wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the fries order size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the wedges order size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Merge side preparation alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Menu components ready"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuMerge" name="Continue to burger preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_BurgerStatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_BurgerStatus">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StatusUpdateSent" name="Status update sent"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAsk" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskToReceiveMenu" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveMenuToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoiceYes" name="Wants a menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">menuSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoiceNo" name="Wants just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">menuSelected = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplitToSideQuestion" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideQuestionToReceive" sourceRef="Task_AskSideChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSideToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoiceFries" name="Wants fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sideChoice = 'fries'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoiceWedges" name="Wants wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sideChoice = 'wedges'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMergeToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoinToMenuMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuMergeToBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerToDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="End_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimerToUpdate" sourceRef="Boundary_BurgerStatusTimer" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToStatusEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="End_StatusUpdateSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic burger seller" processRef="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuQuestion" name="Menu or burger question" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuChoice" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger choice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question" sourceRef="Task_AskSideChoice" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_SideQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Enthusiastic status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
